title: File Streaming with Range Support
description: Stream files with proper headers, support HTTP Range requests for partial content (206), and handle large file streaming.

steps.title: File stream endpoint
steps.description: Implement GET /stream/:file that streams a file from the in-memory store. If the file is stored, pipe it to the response.
hints: Store files in memory as Buffer objects
Stream the buffer using res.send or a Readable stream
Return 404 if file does not exist

steps.title: Proper content headers
steps.description: Enhance the GET /stream/:file endpoint to set correct Content-Type and Content-Length headers before streaming the file.
hints: Detect content type from file extension
Set Content-Length to the buffer size

steps.title: Range request support
steps.description: Support HTTP Range requests on GET /stream/:file. If a Range header is present (e.g. 'bytes=0-99'), return 206 Partial Content with only the requested byte range and Content-Range header.
hints: Parse the Range header for start and end bytes
Slice the buffer to the requested range
Return 416 Range Not Satisfiable for invalid ranges

tests.body: Hello World This is a test file for range requests

steps.title: Large file streaming
steps.description: Generate and stream a large file (100MB+) to demonstrate efficient memory usage. The endpoint should generate binary data on-the-fly and stream it without loading all into memory at once.
hints: Generate data in chunks and stream progressively
Set Content-Length to the full size upfront
Use chunked transfer or fixed-length streaming
